name: Scientific / Orbit Atlas
displayName: 科学空间 · 轨道图谱
description: 深蓝坐标空间、琥珀天体与示意轨道；用扫描、路径绘制和量纲标签说明关系。

canvas.adaptation: Reference composition; reflow freely for 9:16 or 1:1. Not an automatic aspect converter.

audio.note: Silent concept preview. Narration, character, voice, language and speaking rate remain user-controlled.

dependencies.fonts: Operating-system Arial/Georgia/monospace; none bundled or fetched. Font metrics can vary across systems.

variants.name: 轨迹讲解
variants.recipe: Isolate one orbit path, keep the planet dim, and introduce labels at narrative beats. Put actual units and source beside real data.

variants.name: 信号对照
variants.recipe: Promote spectrum.svg to the main visual for an abstract signal lesson. For quantitative content replace its points and add labeled axes and uncertainty.

usage.remix: Use spatial paths and restrained coordinate labels to explain relationships. The supplied planet, paths and spectrum are illustrative, not data. Replace the curve with a sourced dataset before making scientific claims.
usage.avoid: No physical simulation is claimed. Never present the fictional spectrum as measurements or convert decorative labels into unsupported quantities.
usage.motion: 0–1.8s: atlas arrives; 1–4s: trajectory draws; 3–5s: schematic curve appears. A marker follows a deterministic SVG path and phase text progresses.
usage.portrait: Stack heading, atlas and legend; remove the small curve panel or give it a dedicated scene. Keep the explicit schematic/data disclaimer visible.
usage.captions: Reserve an uncluttered caption band. Recompose labels rather than obscuring subtitles. Preview footer labels are not subtitles.
